name: Clean up factory resources after merge
description:
Factory review recommendation 15 of 20.

## Context

The review found 82 worktrees, many pr-assets branches and a long-lived agentic-tui daemon on rook.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add a Done Stage Prompt or equivalent completion workflow for resource cleanup.
- Remove merged task branches, associated pr-assets branches and worktrees on the machine that owns them, after verifying they contain no unmerged work.
- Stop task-owned daemons and enable repository branch deletion on merge where appropriate.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PLAN NEEDS REVISION before implementation acceptance. Equivalent completion workflow instead of Done Prompt is approved direction; no historical dispatch. Keep every pr-assets branch for now and coordinate ROW-65 retention: deleting linked evidence is not accepted. Your Story explicitly includes associated pr-assets cleanup, so explain a retained-evidence condition/archival prerequisite rather than silently dropping that criterion. ROW-65 owns evidence-retention policy; you own cleanup script/worktree and task-owned daemon mechanics. Per-task daemon isolation is good; do not stop shared/existing daemons or archive other workers. Repository delete_branch_on_merge setting remains proposal only, no execution yet. Require protected main/base/default branches never deleted, no active assigned worktrees/threads (CWD scan alone cannot establish inactivity), exact branch/PR ownership, and recheck refs immediately before actions. Avoid remote deletion race: if you cannot atomically ensure the remote ref is still the verified merged tip without any force push, retain it/report for supervisor instead of deleting a possibly advanced ref. Provide revised plan covering these and evidence retention before coding. No ADR needed for guidance alone. Four checks/manual temp-repo evidence remain appropriate.
